title: thelypteris srilankensis
intro: Thelypteris srilankensis, commonly known as the Srilankan maidenhair fern, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris srilankensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
